jobs.title: Care & Service Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the team

As part of Careem’s mission to simplify and improve lives across the greater Middle East, the Care Operations team serves as the backbone of operational excellence. The team is responsible for ensuring that every customer and Captain interaction reflects the trust people place in Careem—resolving issues with speed and empathy and continuously optimizing the journey experience across all services.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, hands-on, and results-driven Care & Service Operations Lead to drive operational precision, vendor governance, and service quality across our customer and Captain support ecosystem. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for queue health, SLA performance, and CSAT integrity, serving as the critical bridge between Care Operations, Product, Tech, and external vendor partners.

What you'll do

- Query raw system data (SQL/Trino) to investigate SLA breaches, CSAT fluctuations, and operational anomalies beyond surface-level dashboards.

- Own vendor accountability across BPO partners, executing independent audits frameworks and calibration sessions to safeguard quality standards.

- Create and update step-by-step SOPs and process flows to keep team procedures accurate

- Query raw system data (SQL/Trino) to investigate SLA breaches, CSAT fluctuations, and operational anomalies beyond surface-level dashboards.

- Monitor daily Customer and Captain SLA performance, proactively mitigating breaches and eliminating backlog bottlenecks across cross-functional handoffs.

- Partner with Product and Tech to scope, test (UAT), and launch workflow automations, authoring comprehensive SOPs for high-friction processes.

- Build weekly performance decks, translate complaint trends into scalable agent coaching, and align cross-functional leads on operational priorities.

What you'll need

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Operations Management, or a related field.

- 2-3 years in Care Operations, Quality Assurance, or Customer Experience, ideally within a high-volume, multi-vendor mobility or tech environment.

- Strong analytical mindset with hands-on ability to query raw databases (SQL/Trino) to conduct independent root-cause deep dives beyond high-level dashboard summaries.

- Proven track record in mapping end-to-end customer and Captain journeys, identifying operational friction points, and converting insights into structural workflow fixes.

- Exceptional written communication skills with expertise in drafting clear, comprehensive SOPs, executive escalation write-ups, and process flows to support platform migrations.

- Direct experience in managing third-party vendor partners (BPOs), holding partners accountable to stringent QA/SLA benchmarks, and running calibration programs.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, capable of serving as the primary operational bridge between Care Ops, Product, Tech, Marketing, and ground teams.

- Excellent verbal and visual communication skills, with proficiency in building executive-ready decks and documents (Google Workspace / MS Office Suite) and delivering on-floor training.

- Able to break down complex operational issues into clear, data-backed solutions.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

- Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

- Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.

- Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.

- Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)

- Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy and Care Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

This role sits at the intersection of Operations, Care, Product, and Finance — turning business priorities into structured programs, and using data and policy design to make customer experience consistent, efficient, and scalable across every market and business line we operate in.

You'll act as an individual contributor with real strategic influence: owning recurring performance reviews with vertical and market leads, running the analysis that shapes product and commercial roadmaps, and leading the policy decisions that define how the business treats its customers when things go right — and when they don't.

Key Responsibilities

1. Performance Governance & Business Reviews

-
Own the cadence of recurring performance reviews across multiple business lines — monthly and weekly reviews, goal check-ins, and steering updates — ensuring decks are current, owners are clear, and action items get tracked to closure.

-
Partner with vertical, commercial, and finance leads to keep review formats, targets, and metrics consistent as the business evolves.

-
Build a single, credible view of operational and customer experience performance that leadership can act on.

2. End-2-End Customer Experience Governance including ownership of L0 metrics

- Aligns Product, Operations, Care around shared journey-level priorities and drive consistent policy and quality of service.

- Leads experience reviews, journey mapping workshops, and gap-closure plans.

- Ensures policy, process, product, and communication remain consistent even as platforms evolve.

- Creates a unified view of customer experience performance across teams.

- Own CSAT and Contact Rate Careem-level  L0 metrics for Care.

3. Cohort-Led Customer Policy Design

- Lead the design and rollout of customer-facing policies — refunds, compensation, service-recovery thresholds — balancing customer experience against cost.

- Develop segment-led (cohort-based) policies that treat customers differently based on value and history, while keeping the system simple enough to operate at scale.

- Run the governance forums that keep policy application consistent across markets, and partner with legacy or market-specific teams to bring outlying markets onto a common framework over time.

4. Contact Rate & Product led Defect Reduction

- Own and publish a regular, company-wide contact rate report — tracking performance against target by business line, surfacing the top drivers of customer contact, and translating them into a clear set of ask’s for product and commercial teams.

- Maintain the dashboards and source data that back this reporting, and keep the distribution list and format current as stakeholders change.

- Work with data and analytics partners to keep root-cause analysis sharp enough to drive real roadmap decisions, not just track a number.

5. Cross-Functional Program Management

- Act as the connective tissue between Operations, Care, Product, Finance, and Data teams — translating strategy into structured, trackable programs with clear ownership.

- Represent Operations and Care in cross-functional forums and leadership reviews, and keep a live view of open decisions, dependencies, and risks across workstreams.

Cross-Functional Interfaces & Forums

Key Teams: Care Ops, Product & Engineering, Workforce Management, Vendor Ops, Policy, Data & Analytics, Operations Excellence, Finance

Core Forums:

- Operational governance and Customer experience reviews

- Defect-reduction and Lumina forums

- Automation and AI roadmap reviews

- Program steering committees

- Quarterly and monthly business reviews

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of experience in operations strategy, program management, business operations, or a related analytical/cross-functional role.

- A track record of owning recurring reporting or business-review cadences with senior stakeholders, end to end.

- Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with dashboards and raw data to build a narrative, not just a chart.

- Experience designing or governing customer-facing policy, ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce, delivery, or platform business.

- Excellent stakeholder management — able to align Product, Finance, Commercial, and Operations partners who don't always start from the same page.

- Comfort with ambiguity: this role is as much about building the structure as running it.

- Familiarity with workforce management, vendor operations, or AI-enabled quality/automation tooling is a plus, though not required.

What Success Looks Like

- A predictable, trusted cadence of performance reviews that leadership relies on.

- Customer policies that are consistent, cohort-aware, and easy to apply across markets.

- A measurable, sustained reduction in customer contact driven by root-cause fixes, not just workarounds.

- Stronger cross-functional execution — fewer dropped handoffs between Operations, Care, Product, and Finance.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

- Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

- Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.

- Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.

- Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)

- Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

jobs.title: Associate Director of ERP Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on ERP Head to lead Careem's ERP Department, covering Oracle Fusion Financials, Procurement (Quik), HCM/Payroll, and Integration streams (Oracle Integration Cloud/OIC, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure/OCI). Based on how this function actually operates day to day, this is a working leadership role: the Head is expected to personally triage, approve, and unblock production issues (access requests, purchase requisitions, integration/OIC errors) rather than only delegate them, while also owning team management, the Oracle vendor relationship, automation initiatives (RPA/AI), and quarterly planning for the department. This is a hands-on role: the candidate must personally review and resolve tickets, approve access/PR requests, and troubleshoot Oracle/OIC/Okta issues directly, in addition to leading the team.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead and manage the ERP Department across its Financials/Procurement (Quik), HCM/Payroll, and Integration streams, with direct reports on the team.

- Approve team expense claims and handle day-to-day people-management tasks for direct reports.

- Set and enforce team-wide delivery discipline, such as requiring every support/project task to be logged against a JIRA ticket before effort is recognized, including personally maintaining the tracking sheet used to enforce this.

- Run team learning and knowledge-sharing sessions — circulating Oracle upgrade documentation, RPA/AI automation demos, and OIC/OCI technical material — to build capability across the department.

- Recognize and communicate wins across streams (e.g., acknowledging the wider ERP team, the Quik team, and contributors to the HR stream) to keep the department aligned and motivated, including offering personal support to team members during difficult personal circumstances.

Hands-On Production Support & Governance

- Personally review and approve or reject access and Purchase Requisition (PR) tickets in Oracle (e.g., Procurement tab access, business-unit-specific access, HR data access) rather than only delegating.

- Triage incoming support tickets and assign them to the right engineer, then follow up until resolution.

- Directly troubleshoot Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) execution failures and instance/flow ID issues arising from platform upgrades, and Oracle/Okta account and access issues for employees, contractors (EOR/COR arrangements), and external business-partner users (e.g., Uber-side accounts).

- Coordinate with the People team on employee lifecycle events (leavers, COR contract conversions, terminations) and their downstream impact on Oracle/Okta access.

- Escalate and coordinate with IT/InfoSec and network/security teams on issues affecting ERP systems.

Oracle Vendor & Environment Management

- Own the relationship with Oracle for support, environment reviews, Service Requests (SRs), and upgrade planning (e.g., OIC/OCI upgrades, Oracle Fusion Identity upgrades), including attending Oracle-hosted webinars, product-manager sessions (e.g., OIC + RPA sessions), and office hours.

- Coordinate with external ERP implementation consultants on delivery of ERP initiatives.

- Review production environments and integration allowlists ahead of major Oracle changes/upgrades (e.g., flow/instance ID changes on OIC version upgrades) and align the team on go/no-go decisions and rollout timing.

Automation, Innovation & Process Improvement

- Sponsor and drive automation initiatives that cut manual effort and cost — e.g., an in-house AI- powered invoice processing solution (built on Oracle Document Understanding/AI) that reduced per-invoice processing time from 2–3 minutes to 30–35 seconds, at a fraction of the cost of Oracle's equivalent tooling.

- Drive cross-system consolidation projects, such as unifying supplier onboarding into a single Supplier Qualification Module on Oracle's Redwood interface.

- Promote adoption of automation and AI/RPA tools within the team to reduce repetitive, manual work, personally sourcing and circulating relevant tooling and demos to the team.

Planning, Reporting & Stakeholder Management

- Own quarterly planning and prioritization for the ERP Department and report progress directly to senior business stakeholders.

- Act as the primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders — Finance/FinOps, People/HR, IT/InfoSec, Security, and regional business units — on ERP-related issues and change requests, including cross-team data mapping (e.g., payroll-to-Kyriba report/profile mapping across markets).

- Manage shared planning artifacts (trackers, shared sheets) and ensure clean ownership transfer/continuity within the team.

- Proactively flag system-wide issues to the right stakeholders and follow through to resolution.

What You'll Need

- Hands-On Experience: Proven, personal (not delegated) experience triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving Oracle Fusion/Oracle Cloud/OIC access, integration, and configuration issues — comfortable working tickets directly, not only through direct reports.

- Oracle Applications: Strong working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and OCI, Oracle Procurement (Purchase Requisition/PR processes), Oracle Financials/GL reporting, and Oracle HCM/Payroll.

- Identity & Access: Familiarity with Oracle-Okta access provisioning/deprovisioning and troubleshooting access for employees, contractors, and external/business-partner users.

- Vendor & Program Management: Experience managing relationships with ERP vendors (Oracle) and external implementation consultants; comfortable raising and tracking Service Requests (SRs) and attending Oracle product/upgrade sessions.

- Automation & AI Adoption: Track record of sponsoring or delivering automation/AI-driven solutions (e.g., document/invoice processing, RPA, system consolidation) with measurable time and cost savings.

- People Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing a technical team — approvals (expenses, access requests), workload distribution, and enforcing delivery discipline such as ticket-based tracking.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work across Finance, People/HR, IT/InfoSec, and regional business units to resolve issues and drive initiatives.

- Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant Oracle Cloud certifications are a plus.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

- Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

- Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.

- Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.

- Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)

- Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Manager - ERP Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About The Role
We are seeking an analytical, results-driven Senior Integration Manager – ERP Digital Transformation for Oracle Cloud Integrations & Fusion Applications to spearhead our Oracle integration domain. This role focuses entirely on designing, deploying, and supporting robust solutions within the Oracle Cloud ecosystem. You must have hands-on experience and be personally capable of building, configuring, and troubleshooting integrations, PL/SQL code, and cloud configurations rather than operating purely in an oversight capacity. In this role you will possess extensive expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Identity & Access Management (Okta/SSO), and Oracle Fusion Cloud modules, demonstrating a strong capability to bridge complex technical workflows and integrations with core business objectives across Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and consumer-facing platforms

What You'll Do

Integration & Cloud Architecture

- Hands-on design, development, and maintenance of secure enterprise integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud and multiple external platforms (consumer applications, collaboration tools, identity providers, banking systems, and custom systems) using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and REST/SOAP APIs.

- Direct working knowledge of OIC adapter types including REST Adapter, SOAP Adapter, HCM Adapter, FTP Adapter, Local DB (Connectivity Agent), and Callback Integrations, along with XML Bursting for automated report/document distribution.

- Administer and configure Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including OCI Vault, OCI Functions, and API Gateways, to build and secure scalable, serverless backend architectures.

- Implement enterprise security protocols, including token-based authentication (JWT Tokens) and certificate-based authentication, across cloud endpoints and system-to-system integrations, including API banking/payment security for external banking communication (e.g., Host-to Host/H2H integrations, Kyriba payment integrations).

- Deploy advanced intelligent automation solutions utilizing Oracle Document Understanding Services, OCR tools, and Generative AI frameworks to extract and structure meaningful information from unstructured data payloads and documents.

Identity, Access & Platform Administration

- Own end-to-end Oracle Identity/IAM platform activities, including Oracle-Okta integration and functional team/attribute mapping, Google SSO and Okta application assignment, and user provisioning/migration during platform upgrades.

- Administer Oracle APEX workspace access and page-level security (grant/revoke access) using custom PL/SQL packages, ensuring least-privilege access across INTEGPROD and other environments.

- Coordinate supplier and internal user identity activities such as password-reset campaigns and access audits tied to Oracle Fusion identity upgrades.

Data Migration & Analytics

- Lead complex, large-scale cloud data migration pipelines and inbound data loading activities using Oracle HCM Data Loader (HDL), Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL), and File-Based Data Import (FBDI) frameworks - including hands-on execution of automation runs (e.g., expense/cost account HDL automation) and data reconciliation.

- Develop custom, interactive business intelligence dashboards and complex enterprise reports utilizing Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), OAC, and BI Publisher including catalog/item master and payroll register reporting.

- Configure and optimize advanced delivery features such as XML bursting to streamline automated report distribution and scheduling to corporate clients and internal stakeholders

Application Development & Governance

- Build responsive, custom cloud extensions and interactive forms leveraging the Oracle APEX platform, Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS), Application Development Framework (ADF), and Process Cloud Service (PCS).

- Write high-performance, robust PL/SQL code — including complex queries, packages, stored procedures, functions, and database triggers — tailored for cloud system environments and staging environments.

- Define, implement, and enforce strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for change requests affecting application functionalities, configurations, or data objects.

- Collaborate directly with cross-functional corporate stakeholders (Finance, HR, Procurement, Catalog/Consumer Platform Ops) to identify critical data use cases and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT), knowledge transfer, and technical handovers for seamless project delivery.

Incident & Vendor Management

- Act as the hands-on point of contact for production integration incidents (e.g., Oracle Cloud outages, catalog/report sync failures), performing root cause analysis and driving resolution directly, including raising and managing P0/priority support requests with Oracle.

- Coordinate with Oracle Support and third-party vendors/partners for platform upgrades (e.g., Oracle Identity platform migrations) with minimal business disruption.

What You'll Need

- Core Cloud Applications: Hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including OCI Vault, API Gateways, and OCI Administration.

- Integration & Adapters: Practical, hands-on experience building integrations using REST/SOAP Adapters, HCM Adapter, FTP Adapter, Local DB/Connectivity Agent, and Callback Integrations; strong command of REST/SOAP API consumption and JWT/certificate-based authentication.

- Identity & Access Management: Experience with Oracle Identity Cloud/IAM, Okta-Oracle Fusion integration, and Google SSO/application provisioning.

- Payments & Banking Integration: Exposure to payment platform integrations such as Kyriba, Host-to-Host (H2H) banking integrations, and API-based banking security/payload authentication.

- Module Expertise: Strong technical understanding across Oracle Cloud Financials (Payables, Receivables, General Ledger), Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM – Inventory, Purchasing, Order Management), and Oracle HCM (Core HR, Expense/Cost Accounting).

- Enterprise Business Processes: Thorough working knowledge of standard end-to-end enterprise cycles, specifically Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P).

- Data & Reporting: Hands-on experience with HDL, HSDL, FBDI data loading frameworks, and OTBI/OAC/BI Publisher reporting with XML Bursting.

- Development & Tools: Hands-on proficiency in Oracle APEX, PL/SQL (packages, procedures, functions, triggers), VBCS, ADF, and PCS.

- Experience: Proven hands-on (not purely managerial) track record delivering and supporting Oracle Cloud integrations in a production environment, including direct incident troubleshooting and vendor/Oracle Support coordination.

- Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a relevant technical discipline. Professional Oracle Cloud certifications are highly valued.

What We’ll Provide You

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

- Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

- Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
